info.title: Telegram Bot Manager API
info.description:
REST API behind the Telegram Mini App admin panel.

Authenticate by posting the WebApp `initData` string to `/api/auth/telegram`,
then send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other
request. Tokens are short-lived; renew them with `/api/auth/refresh` rather than
re-posting `initData`, which Telegram only lets you use once.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description:
Always 200 while the process is up — no dependency is consulted.

A liveness probe that fails when Redis is down would have the orchestrator
restart a perfectly healthy API, which does not bring Redis back.

get.summary: Readiness probe
get.description: 503 while a dependency the API cannot serve without is unreachable.

re-enabled needs its job back; recomputing unconditionally is cheaper than
reasoning about which field combinations imply a re-arm.

post.summary: Add to or subtract from a member's reputation
post.description:
A relative delta, not an absolute score.

DECISION: the panel sends `+5`/`-5` rather than the new total. Two admins
correcting the same farmed score at once would otherwise overwrite each
other; a delta applied by the database composes, whichever order it lands in.

post.summary: Open a Stars or CryptoBot invoice for a plan
post.description:
Quote and open an invoice; nothing about the chat changes until it is paid.

Opening a second invoice while a first is unpaid is allowed on purpose — a
payer who abandoned a Stars link and came back for crypto would otherwise be
stuck behind their own dead invoice. Both carry the same signed payload, and
settlement is idempotent per provider payment id.

ModuleMeta.title: ModuleMeta

PlatformCapabilities.title: PlatformCapabilities
PlatformCapabilities.description:
Optional integrations that are actually usable on this deployment.

Keeping these server-derived prevents the Mini App from sending a customer
into a checkout or an AI setting which the deployment cannot fulfil.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description:
RFC7807-like error body returned by the API exception handler.

`title` is localized for the caller and safe to show; `detail` is the
developer-facing message. `code` is the stable machine-readable discriminator
the Mini App branches on, and `context` carries whatever the error knew (the
required plan for a paywall, the offending field for a validation failure).

ReputationAdjust.title: ReputationAdjust
ReputationAdjust.description: A manual correction, expressed as a delta so concurrent edits compose.
